notes.title: *** Madness Fantasy BIG update IS OUT NOW!! + price cut!! ***
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128596/7e9cc0d6b450e426e94e0bf57b7cba4fa0c0190c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Here we go![/b][/h1]
It's with immense pride that I announce that[b] the first big expansion for Madness Fantasy is finally available[/b]! But wait!! To celebrate the event it's coming with [b]a new unexpected price cut[/b]! You can now purchase MF for only[b] 6.99$[/b]!! What are you waiting for?


[h1][b]Economic System[/b][/h1] 
A new economic system has been introduced that allows you to earn and spend [b]MFMoney[/b], the currency of the game! MFMoney can be earned in a variety of ways, from betting through [b]mini-games[/b] to using certain types of [b]gadgets[/b], also introduced for the first time with this update!
Through MFMoney you can purchase aesthetic changes to the game and new gadgets, which will increase the variety of things to do in the city while in [b]free mode[/b].


[h1][b]Inventory[/b][/h1] 
An [b]inventory[/b] has now been added to the game interface, a customizable system that can contain up to 6 gadgets at a time, which can be equipped in real time to quickly change your [b]gameplay style[/b] within the strolls in city!


[h1][b]Minigames[/b][/h1] 
As you progress through the main story, several mini-games will be made available on the main map, allowing you to place bets and thus earn MFMoney!


[h1][b]Motels[/b][/h1] 
The [b]motels[/b] available in the map have finally been activated, allowing you to quickly scroll the time in order to access the different types of favorite minigames (some of them are available only during the day, others only at night).


[h1][b]Extra updates[/b][/h1] 
Some minor bugs have been fixed and some pedestrian management systems have been revised.


[h1][b]What's next[/b][/h1] 
This first big update has laid the foundations for future expansions, which can now be implemented much easier and faster, but it's all up to you how much the world of MF can grow, so download the game, [b]have fun and share your gaming experiences[/b] with friends or the community! Go wild with
Jackie, Max, Marv, Hank and Dex in this crazy adventure!

See you soon!

notes.title: *** Madness Fantasy BIG update announcement + 50% discount!! ***
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37128596/7e9cc0d6b450e426e94e0bf57b7cba4fa0c0190c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]It's official![/b][/h1] 
A [b]huge expansion[/b] for Madness Fantasy is coming in the next few weeks!! This expansion will revolutionize gameplay in free roaming sessions and also will going to considerably increase game replayability!

[h1][b]50% discount[/b][/h1] 
But before going into detail, remember that for a few days Madness Fantasy is available with a [b]50% discount!![/b] Don't miss this incredible chance to have it [b]half priced!![/b]

[h1][b]Economic system[/b][/h1] 
An economic system will be introduced with the possibility of earning and spending money. Money can be earned in different ways, from betting through minigames to using certain types of [b]gadgets[/b], also introduced for the first time with this update.
The money earned can be spent in various ways, with collectibles and new gadgets that will be released over time, but also through the fencing of stolen vehicles and much more.

[h1][b]Inventory[/b][/h1] 
In the game interface, an [b]inventory[/b] can be called up, a customizable system that will contain up to 5 gadgets at a time, which can be used in your strolls in the city.
These gadgets will allow you to make the free roaming experience very varied, adding depth and fun (did someone say there will be a "raimbow-shooter"?).
[b]Gadgets, aesthetic changes and collectibles[/b] can be purchased with virtual money earned within the game in a special shop that will be created for the occasion!

[h1][b]Minigames[/b][/h1] 
As an implementation for the [b]economic system[/b], many minigames will be available in the city, where you can place bets and then win or lose money. Over time, new and ever new minigames will be released!

[h1][b]Motels[/b][/h1] 
The motels on the map will be "activated" to allow you to stay overnight and thus to pass time. This is because some minigames and situations will only be available at certain times of the day or night.

[h1][b]Minimap goals[/b][/h1] 
An option will be added to the game menu that will allow you to watch in real time on the minimap all the objectives currently in progress, whether they are from the main story, side missions or other, with relative description!

I will keep you updated in the coming weeks, in the meantime take advantage of this huge discount and start entering this crazy world of Madness Fantasy!

See ya!

notes.title: Game updates v1.0.8
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sTmlPfFj1uI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Small updates are growing![/b][/h1]

[b]Madness Fantasy[/b] keeps improving! 

After collecting your first feedbacks I immediately got to work to make small corrections and improvements, here is in detail what changes in this updated version:

[b]***  Bug Fixes ***[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the language bug of a secondary mission, now it works correctly and you don't have to take a language course to understand what happens!
[*] Fixed a collision in the city that allowed the Player to cross a fence, you can no longer be a little ghosts that scares people around him.
[/list]

[b]*** Improvements *** [/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the volume of the sound effects while driving the vehicles, your eardrums are safe!
[*] Bonus message styles are now graphically improved, you can now unlock more nice bonuses! Show your friends how good you are!
[*] OddCity's night graphics has been improved, with more beautiful atmospheres! Now you can do some crazy rides in a nicer environment!
[/list]

[h1][b]Some curiosities[/b][/h1]

Did you know that Madness Fantasy was made in years of hard work by a single person who had to multiply?

[b]*** If you have not already done so, help a small developer, play Madness Fantasy today and become part of this crazy game world! ***[/b]

Keep playing Madness Fantasy and follow the next updates!


See you soon!
